prediction.reason: Graduation needs at least 160 MC. With a 26 MC cap, a semester's load can only be 24, 25 or 26 MC, because only CS3216 and CS3217 are 5 MC and every other non-industrial module is a multiple of 4. Over 6 semesters the most that can be scheduled is 146 MC, e.g. 26+5x24 or 25+25+4x24. The one allowed industrial-experience option adds at most 12 MC, since it is exempt from the load cap. That gives a maximum of 158 MC, which is below 160.
